page_topic_one_liner: Landing page creation — hero section, single CTA focus, conversion elements, SEO optimization, and CRO best practices
differentiator_vs_generic: This is landing page design and CRO SEO, NOT GEO/LLM chat. Hero must show a focused single-page conversion layout with hero headline + CTA button — NOT a multi-page site map, blog index, or AI chat interface.
visual_anchors: HERO (~55% canvas): landing page above-the-fold wireframe — large H1 headline blur, subheadline line blur, prominent accent CTA button (solid fill, no readable button copy), hero image placeholder on right, minimal nav (logo blur only, no menu clutter)
Secondary: single-focus conversion layout — full page wireframe showing hero → benefits icons row → testimonial stars → bottom CTA (no sidebar, no blog feed)
Tertiary: conversion funnel silhouette — ad/email click icon → landing page → form/checkmark (3-step blur icons)
anti_patterns: LLM chat panel as hero (this is landing page CRO not GEO)
Multi-page website sitemap or blog archive layout
Generic homepage with full navigation mega-menu
Affiliate dashboard unrelated to conversion pages

en.headline: LANDING PAGES
en.subtitle: Conversion & SEO
en.composition: Visual-only editorial collage for landing page creation guide. HERO: above-the-fold landing page wireframe occupying right two-thirds — blurred H1 headline, subheadline lines, large accent titian-red CTA button center-left, hero image placeholder right, stripped nav with logo blur only. Secondary: vertical single-focus page wireframe — hero, 3 benefit icon blocks, star testimonial row, repeat CTA at bottom, no sidebar. Tertiary: tiny 3-step conversion funnel icons ad→page→checkmark. Title block top-left. Paper collage torn edges, halftone. NO LLM chat UI, NO full website nav menus, NO readable CTA copy text, NO extra UI labels on canvas.
